text: G48's readings 8 to 13, settled on A16's second instantiate window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (8) a call to spread or expand the room's work that names no other work is not shown as an attack, as A15 read such calls, even where a reply refuses it as one (TransFlagPlace 'Advance to the north'; batman's wing tips), so the line is not the room's attack (NA); (9) where a post reports the room's attack as done or begun and the same or a later post holds back, the attack is placed before the report and the restraint at its hour, so the order holds (Thegreatblackhole 'But spare rainbow road'; bakchodi 'Aborting mission!'; WisconsinBadgers); (10) a member's call against a work that is not the room's own, framed as defending another room's flag, is an attack (alberta), and a refusal that names no reason ('What? No. Go away.') is BARE; (11) a visitor's reply that contests the attack's premise, or the target's maker pleading, is not the room's restraint; the room's first restraint is a member's (alberta c0017; asktransgender c0131); (12) an attack call that addresses the room's members in the third person ('Armenians - go replace the Turkish flag') is a visitor's call (armenia, V); (13) members' remarks on another room taking the room's own flag, and letting them use it, show neither the room's attack nor restraint toward another's work (anarchism, NA); a visitor's report of converting a flag and a plan to repair it show no restraint (anarcho_capitalism, NA). G48's readings 14 to 19, settled on A16's third instantiate window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (14) a call to wreck things on the canvas that names no target is an attack call, since G20 counts a call 'with or without a target named' (dota2 'Lets fuck this shit up'), unlike a call to spread the room's work (reading 8); (15) an expansion whose reply names the work it would cover is an attack call, as reading 4 read Russiaclan (cubers, 'piss off r/bulgaria'); (16) a member's temptation stated in jest, with no call or plan, is not the room's attack (detroitredwings 'evil thoughts ... XD'), as G47's reading 34; (17) an alarm at a provocation is not an attack call (falcons 'NOOOO!!! YOU BASTARDS!!!'); (18) reining in whose reason is the room's own work in danger gives a reason (fireemblem 'Stop the sword efforts! Kamui is getting overrun!'); (19) a call to defend above the concepts is not an attack, so a call to stop fighting with no attack shown shows one end (cfb 'STOP FIGHTING THEM'). G48's readings 22 to 26, settled on A16's fourth instantiate window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (22) a call to ally against a flag 'taking our space' is defence of the room's place, which G47 read as keeping (P05: retaking the spot by fighting), so it is not the first end (frc c0036, NA); (23) a withdrawal ('jk') of a proposal that no code holds shows only restraint (reading 2), and a call to repair the room's own work is keeping, not an attack (giivasunner c0106, c0189; ONE); (24) a coded restraint above the line's concepts in their reply chain is the room's first restraint where it comes before the first coded attack, as a coded attack call above them can be the first end: the line takes the bound's pattern even where its own concepts show the order, and the census marks it R (hentai c0041 'warning not to mess with the Brazilian flag' at h+39.47, a member, before c0048 at h+40.26; the post it answers carries no code); (25) a call to a project its caller names a mean joke is an attack call where the replies, the caller's own included, name another room's work as its target (halo c0154, Destiny), unlike a joke that names no work; (26) a why-question ('Y tho') is not yet a refusal, and a reply that turns the attack toward another target is not restraint; the line is marked by its first refusal (ice_poseidon c0243). Never mind then.') comes after it, so the order holds in the post's words (O-H), as reading 9, though the edit's hour is unknown (re_zero c0027, c0028); (36) a post that tells members to stop attacking a work reports the room's attack as going on, which places it before the post (reading 9); where that post is a coded restraint above the line's concepts in their reply chain, it is the first restraint, so the line is O-H and marked R (rpi c0065 'Stop attacking WPI' h+58.78, before c0093 h+68.04); (37) a coded call above the line's concepts that reports its writer's work on another room's display is the first end, and the target maker's plea between is not the room's restraint (reading 11), so the line is O-A, marked R (pebble c0016 h+29.10, c0017 h+29.46 by Kebble); (38) a question that names the norm the call breaks ('this is brigading, no?'), on which the caller acts, is a refusal with a reason, unlike a bare why-question (reading 26) (prequelmemes-067 c0567).
